description: Tuỳ chọn, ưu tiên thấp. (1) Thêm `pnpm browser` (headless Chrome) vào CI sau lần deploy đầu. (2) pnpm/action-setup hiện chỉ sang action kế nhiệm pnpm/setup, cần pnpm 11+; dự án đang pin pnpm 10.33.3. (3) Hai finding nhỏ còn lại từ reviewer: class diff-table và tree-branch chưa có CSS riêng; preview.kill() trong browser-check gửi signal cho wrapper pnpm thay vì vite.

handoff.summary:
t-c70a.4 is done as 3 local commits on main (not pushed): ba68948, de9191d and 2a05676, on base 1eee81c. Lead wrote all of the code; no peer was used. An independent reviewer (codex:gpt-6-astra, read-only) gave PASS on all 7 criteria with no findings. Moving the task to review for main.

(1) CI: the build job now runs `pnpm browser` after smoke and before upload-pages-artifact, with CHROME_PATH=/usr/bin/google-chrome. That is the Chrome GitHub preinstalls. The runner-images manifests for both Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04 list Google Chrome, and install-google-chrome.sh installs it at /usr/bin/google-chrome. So the ubuntu-latest switch (starting 2026-10-19, finishing 2026-11-19, per runner-images#14748) should not break it. The step prints `google-chrome --version` first, so a future image without Chrome fails clearly. A failing check fails the build job, and deploy needs build. Screenshots are uploaded as the artifact `browser-screenshots` (if: !cancelled(), kept 7 days). A new vitest case pins the step order, CHROME_PATH, no continue-on-error, and deploy needs build. I used the preinstalled Chrome instead of browser-actions/setup-chrome: it needs no extra third-party action and no ~150 MB download per run. setup-chrome@v2 is the fallback if a future image drops Chrome.

(2) pnpm: NOT migrated. We keep pnpm 10.33.3 + pnpm/action-setup@v6. Reasons:
- pnpm/setup is young and changes often. The repo was created 2026-05-11, and it has had 3 major versions in 4 months: v1 on Jun 15, v2 on Aug 4 (requires pnpm ≥11), v3 on Sep 20 (breaking cache-key change).
- It has many open reliability issues: #69 hangs until the job timeout after a failed cache restore, #67 store prune empties the cache, #64 intermittent network failures, #47/#48 stale major tags, #51 setup modifies pnpm-lock.yaml, #34/#58 version mismatch.
- pnpm 11 changes defaults: minimumReleaseAge, allowBuilds replacing onlyBuiltDependencies, .npmrc limited to auth/registry.
- pnpm itself is already at v12.10.1, so v11 is not even the current target.
- pnpm 10 is still maintained (10.34.6 released 2026-09-29), and pnpm/action-setup v6.1.0 (2026-09-05) still supports pnpm 10.
Sources: https://github.com/pnpm/setup/releases, https://github.com/pnpm/setup/issues, https://pnpm.io/blog/releases/11.0, https://github.com/pnpm/action-setup/releases. Reconsider once pnpm/setup has a stable major for a few months, together with a deliberate move to pnpm 12.

(3a) JSON Diff table and JSON Tree branches now have their own CSS, using the existing theme tokens for light and dark.
- Before the fix, each row's text inherited its kind's color.
- Diff rows now use neutral text. The kind shows in the badge and a 3px left rule; Before/After values get a soft red/green wash, and empty cells show a muted dash that screen readers skip.
- Tree branches get hover/focus on the toggle, a type chip, and a highlighted guide line when hovering the toggle.
- browser-check now also screenshots JSON Tree (expanded) and JSON Diff (one difference of each kind, and it asserts 4 rows) in light and dark. I looked at all four screenshots.

(3b) smoke and browser-check no longer spawn `pnpm exec vite preview` and kill() it. They use Vite's preview() API in-process through the new scripts/preview-server.mjs, await close(), and fail if anything still listens on the port afterwards.
candidate: base 1eee81c → HEAD 2a05676 on main (local, not pushed)
ba68948 fix(scripts): run vite preview in-process with verified teardown
de9191d style(json): style JSON Diff table and JSON Tree branches
2a05676 ci: run headless-Chrome browser check before deploying
scope: package.json / pnpm-lock.yaml unchanged (no pnpm migration); .alp/ untouched (the pre-existing modified .alp/tasks files are not mine and were not staged)
verification: pnpm typecheck → exit 0 (one TS2532 in the new test was fixed before committing)
pnpm test → Test Files 7 passed, Tests 105 passed (105)
pnpm smoke → 'ok  preview server closed, port 4179 free' / 'smoke: OK (27 tool routes)'
pnpm browser → exit 0, 'chrome: /Applications/Google Chrome.app/...', 'ok   preview server closed, port 4180 free', 'browser-check: OK (27 tool routes + home + 404, 0 console/CSP errors)'
lsof -nP -iTCP:4180 -iTCP:4179 -sTCP:LISTEN after browser → exit 1 (no listener); ps shows no leftover vite or headless Chrome
actionlint 1.7.12 (release binary, checksum-verified) on deploy.yml → 'Found total 0 errors' (the shellcheck/pyflakes rules were skipped because those tools are not installed)
Screenshots .artifacts/screenshots/json-diff-{light,dark}.png and json-tree-{light,dark}.png inspected visually; earlier screenshots confirmed the old whole-row kind coloring

Independent review: reviewer on codex:gpt-6-astra, read-only, verdict PASS for all 7 criteria, no findings. Its sandbox blocked pnpm typecheck/test (EPERM on writes), so it ran read-only equivalents: tsc API, actionlint, lint, YAML assertions, node --check, and source inspection of the installed Vite and Playwright code

Proven only by the real CI run after main pushes: Chrome 154 on the Ubuntu runner works with playwright-core 1.64, Linux headless clipboard and fonts behave, the artifact upload works, and the run time is acceptable (~90s locally)
risks: The hosted workflow has not run yet. The first push to main is the real test of the Linux Chrome/clipboard/fonts behavior. If it fails, deploy is blocked until it is fixed (that is the intended gate), so watch the first run.
Runner Chrome versions change with image updates while playwright-core is pinned in the lockfile. A future Chrome update could break the CDP connection; the gate would catch that, not prevent it.
Adds about 1.5 minutes per deploy (browser-check takes ~90s locally).
If a future Ubuntu image drops /usr/bin/google-chrome, the step fails at the --version line; the fix is to switch to browser-actions/setup-chrome@v2 and use its chrome-path output.
discovered: Cosmetic, pre-existing: in the browser-check fullPage screenshots the sidebar stops at ~860px (sticky 100vh sidebar), so long pages look cut off at the bottom-left. This probably only affects the screenshots, not real use; it needs a quick check.
Future: reconsider moving to pnpm/setup together with pnpm 12 (not 11) once pnpm/setup has a stable major for a few months.
handoff.ownership: My two board claims (p-c001ee05, p-1e4cff6e) have been removed. No peers are running, and the worktree is clean apart from the pre-existing .alp/tasks changes. Main owns the push and the acceptance of t-c70a.4.
